title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Qul a'udhu" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Say: I seek refuge
   B. Say: I thank
   C. Say: I forgive
   D. Say: I worship

2. Which surah is the last surah of the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. An-Naas
   C. Al-Falaq
   D. Al-Fatiha

3. How many verses are in Surah Al-Ikhlas? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 3
   C. 4
   D. 6

4. In which surah does Allah praise the Prophet's great character? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Qalam (68:4)

5. Which is an example of wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing away half a plate you took
   B. Finishing your food
   C. Sharing leftovers with a neighbour
   D. Taking a small portion

6. How much toothpaste should a child use? (1 mark)
   A. A pea-sized amount
   B. None
   C. A full tube
   D. A whole handful

7. What happens when germs feed on sugar left on teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Teeth become stronger
   B. They make acid that causes cavities
   C. Nothing happens
   D. Teeth grow longer

8. Why is it good to have fresh breath when praying and meeting people? (1 mark)
   A. It makes prayer shorter
   B. It is respectful to Allah and to others
   C. It is not important
   D. It makes us tall

9. Which attribute means Allah is free from all faults? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Al-Malik
   C. Al-Basir
   D. Ar-Rahim

10. Kevin returns a lost charger when nobody sees him. Which belief helped him? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   B. Nobody cares
   C. Allah is a picture
   D. Allah is far away

11. Another name for the Angel of Death is (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Izrail
   C. Jibril
   D. Mikail

12. Which prophet helped his father to build the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Yunus
   B. Ismail
   C. Hud
   D. Idris

13. Which prophet is remembered for generosity to guests? (1 mark)
   A. Salih
   B. Yunus
   C. Nuh
   D. Ibrahim

14. Prophet Nuh called his people to Allah for how long? (1 mark)
   A. 50 years
   B. 100 days
   C. 9 years
   D. 950 years

15. Before which of these is wudhu required? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Sleeping only
   C. Playing
   D. Eating

16. How far are the feet washed? (1 mark)
   A. Up to and including the ankles
   B. Toes only
   C. Heels only
   D. Knees

17. What is tayammum? (1 mark)
   A. A type of prayer
   B. Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   C. A dua
   D. Washing with soap

18. What must a girl cover during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only the head
   C. The whole body except face and hands
   D. Only the arms

19. Which of these is broadcast media? (1 mark)
   A. Poster
   B. Magazine
   C. Book
   D. Radio

20. What does "destitute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A rich person
   B. A teacher
   C. A person who has nothing to live on
   D. A farmer

21. Which benefit comes when parents fulfil their duties? (1 mark)
   A. Families become weak
   B. Children become unhappy
   C. No benefit
   D. Children grow safe and well-behaved

22. What does the Qur'an place right after worshipping Allah in Surah 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. Being kind to parents
   B. Journey
   C. Fasting
   D. Trade

23. How can you keep in touch with a relative far away? (1 mark)
   A. Forget
   B. Ignore
   C. Insult
   D. Call, send a message or a gift

24. In which cave did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Hira
   B. Thawr
   C. Safa
   D. Uhud

25. Which qualities of the Prophet did Khadija mention? (1 mark)
   A. He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   B. He is rude
   C. He is lazy
   D. He is careless

26. What can we learn from Ali about young people? (1 mark)
   A. Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   B. Only adults matter
   C. Children cannot help
   D. Children are weak

27. How did Khadija support the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. By harming him
   B. By ignoring him
   C. With comfort and her wealth
   D. By leaving him

28. Who travelled with the Prophet to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Bilal
   C. Zayd ibn Haritha
   D. Ali

29. What do we learn from the Taif journey? (1 mark)
   A. Insult others
   B. Be patient and merciful when hurt
   C. Take revenge
   D. Give up

30. What was the Prophet's answer? (1 mark)
   A. He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   B. He said nothing
   C. He said yes
   D. He asked for destruction

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid. (2 marks)

32. Explain why we should be kind to Allah's creatures. (4 marks)

33. List the steps of brushing teeth correctly. (3 marks)

34. Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life. (3 marks)

35. Give the meanings of shangazi, mjomba and binamu. (3 marks)

36. Describe one complete rak'ah in order. (4 marks)

37. State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid. (2 marks)

38. Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif. (4 marks)

39. Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah. (3 marks)

40. Write the six pillars of Iman and put a mark next to the one studied in this lesson. (4 marks)

41. State two ways a child can earn or save money safely. (2 marks)

42. State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words. (4 marks)

43. Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two. (3 marks)

44. State four obligations of parents to their children. (4 marks)

45. Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well. (3 marks)

46. What are angels created from, and what do they never do? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Say: I seek refuge
   Both protection surahs begin with these words.

2. B — An-Naas
   An-Naas is number 114, the last surah.

3. C — 4
   Al-Ikhlas has four verses.

4. D — Al-Qalam (68:4)
   Surah Al-Qalam 68:4 speaks about his great standard of character.

5. A — Throwing away half a plate you took
   Taking more than you can eat causes waste.

6. A — A pea-sized amount
   A small amount is enough.

7. B — They make acid that causes cavities
   Acid damages the teeth.

8. B — It is respectful to Allah and to others
   A clean mouth shows respect.

9. A — As-Salam
   As-Salam means He is perfect and free of faults.

10. A — Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   He knows Allah sees everything.

11. B — Izrail
   Izrail is commonly used for Malakul Maut.

12. B — Ismail
   Ismail and Ibrahim raised the foundations.

13. D — Ibrahim
   He served his guests a fattened calf.

14. D — 950 years
   Qur'an 29:14 mentions 950 years.

15. A — Prayer
   Prayer needs wudhu.

16. A — Up to and including the ankles
   To the ankles.

17. B — Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   It is a substitute in some cases.

18. C — The whole body except face and hands
   This is the minimum for girls.

19. D — Radio
   Radio and television broadcast.

20. C — A person who has nothing to live on
   Destitute means very poor.

21. D — Children grow safe and well-behaved
   Strong families.

22. A — Being kind to parents
   Kindness to parents is very important.

23. D — Call, send a message or a gift
   Keep contact.

24. A — Hira
   The cave of Hira.

25. A — He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   She praised his character.

26. A — Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   Ali was a boy.

27. C — With comfort and her wealth
   She supported him fully.

28. C — Zayd ibn Haritha
   Zayd was his companion.

29. B — Be patient and merciful when hurt
   The Prophet's example.

30. A — He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   He chose mercy.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah made them and owns them; kindness earns mercy and reward; animals help us; kindness makes us kind to people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid effect.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shangazi: father's sister; mjomba: mother's brother; binamu: cousin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and destiny. Angels are the one studied.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for every two pillars named, 1 mark for identifying angels.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Chores for a small reward with permission, and saving in a box or school scheme.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.
